title: Paired cubes and shared completed cores for conditional kappa = 4.609169e-4
body:
This extends my [PR #130](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/130) at `6a9970a530119174507904e23592fd59ede19a5d`, with one new commit. The #10 → #18 → #24 → #32 → merged #36 → #104 → #115 → #130 proof lineage and attributed ordinary-leaf, semantic/bulk, uniform-recursion and fixed-tape interfaces are retained.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{4609169}{10000000000}=4.609169\times10^{-4}.
$$

## Construction

The new complex local motif uses twelve coordinate pairs and 1,760 ports grouped into eight-port cubes. Its scalar identity is `I=K+H+B`: signed overlap channels supply H, coordinate-star centers supply B, and two 4-by-4 Hadamard/2 blocks per cube supply the involution K. All heavy source injections precede K. The original source registers execute K at a common rank-three frame, deliver their assigned contributions, and undo K at the full frame before scalar cleanup. This adds no K auxiliary bank.

The selected signed DAG has 24,767 additions, 7,724 root uses, 6,074 compatible carrier arcs and 26,417 auxiliary roles. Its 24 coordinate-star frames have rank 22, with copied-center loss 528. The chronological program retains 4,840 entrance gauges of rank 20. Conservative source supports include all visited directions; scalar cancellation is not used to shrink frames.

The global architecture adopts **an664**'s PR #128 completed-core sharing principle. The new cross-stage routing reuses one auxiliary bank successively in three orthogonal h-blocks. Each core includes the complete arbitrary-dirty scalar cleanup and excludes its old independent-bank exterior tail. Exact forward and inverse core actions justify one final correction of width `3 dim(sigma)` for each selected role. Both data banks also pay their rank-two complement calls. Every local operation, copied center and sharing router remains charged.

The complex shared profile has dimension 72, 29,937 roles per cover vertex, rank 2,153,528 and deficit 1,936. Its strict saving is `4856569/10000000000`, with moment gap exceeding `2.0094617553e-10`. The full `O(72,2)` group has 2,556 bits; the actual role stock has 2,571 bits and the maximum child is 60.

The bit branch retains the PR #97 / Swapnil word and original rational frames. It keeps 9,543 certified entrance gauges and omits 2,022. Omitted dirty reads move to the initial zero frame; all later ordinary operations and source frames remain inherited, and retained target chains are certified subsequences. The dimension-69 shared profile has 32,408 roles, rank 2,234,128 and deficit 2,024. The strict coarse saving is `4617656/10000000000`; the full rare-class fallback is charged with moment gap exceeding `1.4386017949e-10`. The stopped ordinary saving is `4613422943/10000000000000`.

The finite guard pays all signed mixer operations, direct dirty reads, original-source involutions and sharing permutations. A numerator-bitlength bound handles the full dirty-response matrix without a positivity assumption. Coordinate-star decoding uses divisor three on one exact grid, retaining completed-child `C1=1`. The external reserve is `p^70000`, with coefficient 20,445; q-adic selectors remain internally borrowed and restored. All 47 strict constraints and seven margins hold, with final absorption gap exceeding `9.9454090434e-11`.

Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/paired-cube-note.tex`: paired identity, original-source chronology, exact core sharing, bit subset and assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `scripts/paired_cube_producer.py`: standard-library reconstruction of the signed graph, frozen carriers, full frames and gauges, with independent finite checks.
- `scripts/paired_cube_bit.py`: source-bound reconstruction of the selected inherited bit gauges and their zero-frame corrections.
- `scripts/paired_cube_network.py` and `certificates/paired-cube-network.json`: complete shared inventories, strict supplier moments, full router/scalar guard and exact assembly.
- `references/paired-cube/`: compact carrier and subset pins; inherited source notices remain in the existing pinned references.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the full theorem. Shared cores, their exact phases and paid tails are justified in the written proof; the finite group is specified mathematically and not materialized by the verifier. Previously submitted source code and upstream review records are preserved.

The new paired-cube schedule, coordinate-star completion, concrete sharing integration, bit subset and exact composition are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial **OpenAI GPT-6 Astra** assistance. Repository integration uses Codex assistance. The substantial PR #128 sharing contribution is explicitly credited; no exclusive priority is claimed for broad sharing or paired-coordinate ideas. Adopted copyrights, source-specific Apache-2.0/CC0 terms and historical assistance notices remain in `SOURCES.json`, `NOTICE` and preserved references. Unselected fallback results, alternative motifs, research screens, large generated graphs and PDFs are excluded.

## Validation

- Verified the supplied incremental-file hashes and all three required base archive hashes.
- Rebuilt the signed paired-cube graph and replayed the compact frozen matching, avoiding a nonunique matching-algorithm dependency. Every selected profile field matched.
- Independently checked 3,097,600 scalar H/K/B entries, the K involution/inverse and original-source frame itinerary, conservative supports, full carrier/backward intersections, signed physical M, center closure, full gauge intersections and reversed target chains.
- Reconstructed the bit slot subset, zero-frame old-value corrections, first-transition changes and inherited target subsequences; matched every selected child multiplicity.
- Certified both exact moments, full rare-class charge, stopped bit saving, finite group/router/scalar envelope, denominator-three grid, row reserve, 47 strict constraints and seven margins.
- Refreshed shared source hashes and dependent joint-dual certificate digests; recomputed joint arithmetic and confirmed unchanged mathematical fields and prior replay payload.
- Checked staged source bindings and deterministic certificate regeneration. Proof sources are included; no PDF compilation was performed.

Unchanged prior producer and full historical suites were not rerun. The incremental command is `make paired-cube-verify`; its scope is documented in `docs/paired-cube.md`.
